mapper.select: SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID AS authrtId, A.AUTHRT_NM AS authrtNm, A.AUTHRT_EXPLN AS authrtExpln, A.SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info U WHERE U.AUTHRT_ID = A.AUTHRT_ID AND U.USE_YN = 'Y') AS userCount FROM authrt_info A WHERE IFNULL(A.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ, A.AUTHRT_ID

SELECT M.MENU_SN AS menuSn, M.MENU_CD AS menuCd, M.WORKSPC_ID AS workspcId, W.WORKSPC_NM AS workspcNm, M.UP_MENU_SN AS upMenuSn, M.MENU_NM AS menuNm, M.MENU_URL_ADDR AS menuUrlAddr, M.MENU_TYPE_NM AS menuTypeNm, M.MENU_ICON_NM AS menuIconNm, M.MENU_LV AS menuLv, M.MENU_SORT_SEQ AS menuSortSeq, CASE WHEN R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS authrtGrntYn FROM menu_info M JOIN workspc_info W ON W.WORKSPC_ID = M.WORKSPC_ID AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN authrt_menu_rel R ON R.MENU_SN = M.MENU_SN AND R.AUTHRT_ID = #{authrtId} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN = 'Y' WHERE M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY W.SORT_SEQ, M.MENU_SORT_SEQ, M.MENU_SN
SELECT M.MENU_CD FROM authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN = R.MENU_SN WHERE R.AUTHRT_ID = #{value} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT DISTINCT M.MENU_URL_ADDR FROM authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN = R.MENU_SN WHERE R.AUTHRT_ID = #{value} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_URL_ADDR IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT M.WORKSPC_ID FROM authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN = R.MENU_SN JOIN workspc_info W ON W.WORKSPC_ID = M.WORKSPC_ID WHERE R.AUTHRT_ID = #{value} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_CD LIKE '%_DASHBOARD_SCREEN' AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.WORKSPC_ID
SELECT WORKSPC_ID FROM user_workspc_rel WHERE USER_ID = #{value} AND DFLT_YN = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authrt_info WHERE AUTHRT_ID = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE AUTHRT_ID = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authrt_info (AUTHRT_ID, AUTHRT_NM, AUTHRT_EXPLN, SORT_SEQ, USE_YN, REG_DT) SELECT #{authrtId}, #{authrtNm}, #{authrtExpln}, IFNULL(MAX(SORT_SEQ), 0) + 1, 'Y', NOW() FROM authrt_info
mapper.update: UPDATE authrt_info SET AUTHRT_NM = #{authrtNm}, AUTHRT_EXPLN = #{authrtExpln}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE AUTHRT_ID = #{authrtId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authrt_menu_rel (AUTHRT_ID, MENU_SN, AUTHRT_GRNT_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{authrtId}, #{menuSn}, 'Y', NOW(), #{loginUserId})

INSERT INTO user_workspc_rel (USER_ID, WORKSPC_ID, DFLT_YN, USE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workspaceId}, 'Y', 'Y', NOW(), #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DFLT_YN = 'Y', USE_YN = 'Y', MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{userId}
